CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 8

2. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 10
   D. 40.5

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.6

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 45
   D. 30

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

7. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

8. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 13
   C. 26
   D. 169

9. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 13

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15
   C. 17
   D. 3

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

12. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

13. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 81

15. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 17
   C. 72
   D. 1

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

17. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

18. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

19. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

21. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

22. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

23. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 20

24. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 14

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
